verses.en: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.
verses.sm: UA maliu atu lesu i Petania, a 0^2 toe ono aso i le fai ai le paseka, sa i ai Lasalo na oti, na ia toe faatu ia te ia nai e ua oti.

verses.en: There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.
verses.sm: Ona sauni ai lea e i latou o le faigaai mā ia i lea mea ; na auauna ai foi Mareta ; a o Lasalo, o ia o le tasi o e na taooto e aai faatasi ma ia.

verses.en: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.
verses.sm: Ona tago ai lea o Maria i le litara o le uu nato tau tele ; ua ia uu ai vae o Iesu, ma sō loi ona vae i lona lauulu; ua tumu foi le fale i le manogi o le uu.

verses.en: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, which should betray him,
verses.sm: Ona fai ane lea o le tasi o ona soo, o Iuta le atalii o Simona le Sekara, o le faalata ia te ia,

verses.en: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?
verses.sm: Pe se a le mea na le faatau ai lena uu manogi i tenari e tolu selau, ma avatu ai i e matitiva?

verses.en: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.
verses.sm: Ua le faapea ane ia, ina ua alofa o ia i e matitiva, a ona o ia o le gaoi, ua ia te ia foi le ete, ma na tauave mea na fafao ai.

verses.en: Then said Jesus, Let her alone: against the day of my burying hath she kept this.
verses.sm: Ona faapea mai ai lea o Iesu, Tuu pea ia ia te ia; ua teu e ia lenei mea mo le aso o le faataimuaga o lo‘u tanuga.

verses.en: For the poor always ye have with you; but me ye have not always.
verses.sm: Auā tou te nonofo pea ma e matitiva, a e tatou te le nonofo pea ma a‘u.

verses.en: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus' sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
verses.sm: Ua iloa e le motu o tagata Iutaia e toatele, ua i ai o ia i lea mea ; ona o atu ai lea o i latou ; e le ona o Iesu lava, a ia latou iloa foi Lasalo, na ia toe faatuina nai e ua oti.

verses.en: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death;
verses.sm: A ua taupulepule le au ositaulaga sili, e fasioti foi ia Lasalo.

verses.en: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.
verses.sm: Auā e toatele Iutaia na o ese ona o ia, ma latOu faatuatua ia Iesu.

verses.en: On the next day much people that were come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
verses.sm: O le taeao ua faalogo ai e le motu o tagata ua o mai i le tausamiga, ua maliu mai Iesu i Ierusalema,

verses.en: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.
verses.sm: ona ave lea e i latou o lau o pama, ma o mai e faafetaiai ia te ia; ona latou alalaga lea, Osana! Ia manuia le afio mai i le suafa o le Alii, o le Tupu o Isaraelu.

verses.en: And Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,
verses.sm: Ua maua e Iesu le tamai asini, ona tietie ai lea, faapei ona tusia,

verses.en: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass's colt.
verses.sm: Aua e te fefe, o oe le tama fafine a Siona; faauta, e afio mai lou Tupu, o loo tietie i le tamai asini.

verses.en: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.
verses.sm: Ua le iloa e ona soo ia mea i le fuataiga; a ua oo Iesu i lona mamalu, ona latou manatua lea ua tusia ia mea ia te ia ; ua latou faia foi ia mea ia te ia.

verses.en: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bare record.
verses.sm: Ona molimau ai lea o le motu o tagata sa latou i ai ma ia, ina ua valaauina e ia o Lasalo nai le tuugamau, ma toe faatu mai ia te ia nai e ua oti.

verses.en: For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.
verses.sm: 0 le mea lea ua faafetaiai ai ia te ia le motu o tagata, auā ua latou faalogo atu na ia faia lena faailoga.

verses.en: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.
verses.sm: Ona fetautalatala‘i ai lea o le au faresaio, Tou te le iloa ea, ua le aoga sa outou mea e fai ? Faauta, ua mulimuli atu le lalolagi ia te ia.

verses.en: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:
verses.sm: Sa i ai isi Eleni faatasi ma e na o ae i le tausamiga e tapuai.

verses.en: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.
verses.sm: O i latou ia ua o ane ia Filipo, o le Petesaita i Kalilaia ia, ua latou ole atu ia te ia, ua faapea atu, Le alii e, matou te fia feiloai ma Iesu.

verses.en: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.
verses.sm: Ona alu ane lea o Filipo, ua ta‘u atu ia Aneterea; ona ta‘u atu ai lea e Aneterea ma Filipo ia Iesu.

verses.en: And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.
verses.sm: Ua tali atu Iesu ia te i laua, ua faapea atu, Ua oo mai ona po e oo ai le Atalii o le tagata i lona mamalu.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.
verses.sm: E moni, e moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, Afai a e le paū le fua o le saito i le eleele ma pala ai, e tumau pea o le mea e tasi; a e afai e pala, ona fua mai ai lea o fua e tele.

verses.en: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.
verses.sm: O le faapelepele i lona ola, e faamāumau e ia i ai; a o le ‘inoūno i lona ola i lenei lalolagi, e leoleo ai e ia e 2(1 oo i le ola faavavau.

verses.en: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.
verses.sm: A fia auauna mai se tasi ia te au, ia mulimuli mai o ia ia te au ; o le mea ou te i ai a‘u, e i ai foi la‘u auauna; pe a auauna mai foi se tasi ia te au, ona viia lea o ia e le Tamā.

verses.en: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.
verses.sm: O loo ātu ne‘i lo‘u loto, pe se a foi se mea ou te fai atu? Lo‘u Tamā e, faaola mai ia te au ai lenei itu aso ; a o le mea lava lea na ou oo mai ai i lenei itu aso.

verses.en: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.
verses.sm: Lou Tamā e, ia e tuuina atu le mamalu i lou suafa. Ona oo mai ai lea o le siufofoga mai le lagi, Ua ou tuuina atu le mamalu, ou te toe tuuina atu foi i ai le mamalu.

verses.en: The people therefore, that stood by, and heard it, said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.
verses.sm: Ona faapea ai lea o le motu o tagata sa tutū ma faalogologo i ai, O loo ua faititili; a ua fai mai nisi, Ua fetalai se agelu ia te ia.

verses.en: Jesus answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o Iesu, ua faapea atu, E lei oo mai lenei siufofoga ona o a‘u, a oua o outou.

verses.en: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.
verses.sm: O loo faasalaina nei lenei lalolagi; e tulia nei le alii o lenei lalolagi.

verses.en: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.
verses.sm: O a‘u foi, afai e siitia au ai le eleele, ou te tosina uma mai tagata ia te au.

verses.en: This he said, signifying what death he should die.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai ane ia lea upu e faailoa ai le uiga o lona maliu o le a maliu ai o ia.

verses.en: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?
verses.sm: Ua tali mai le motu o tagata ia te ia, Ua matou faalogo i le tulafono, e tumau pea le Keriso e faavavau; pe faapefea foi ona e fai mai, E tatau ona siitia i luga o le Atalii o le tagata ? O ai ea lenei Atalii o le tagata ?

verses.en: Then Jesus said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o Iesu ia te i latou, E toe itiiti nai aso e i ai ia te outou le malamalama ; savavali ia manū o ia te outou le malamalama, ne‘i maua outou e le pogisa; o le savali i le pogisa e le iloa e ia le mea e alu i ai.

verses.en: While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. These things spake Jesus, and departed, and did hide himself from them.
verses.sm: Ia outou talia le malamalama, manū o ia te outou le malamalama, ina ia avea o outou ma fanau a le malamalama. Ua fetalai atu ia mea e Iesu, ona maliu ane lea o ia ua lafi ia i latou.

verses.en: But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:
verses.sm: Ua ia faia faailoga e tele lava i o latou luma, a e lei talitonu i latou ia te ia,

verses.en: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?
verses.sm: ina ia taunuu ai le upu a Isaia le perofeta, ua ia faapea mai, Le Alii e, o ai ea ua talitonu i la matou upu e taulogologo atu? ua faaalia foi ia te ai le aao o le Alii ?

verses.en: Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,
verses.sm: O lenei, e le mafai e i latou ona talitonu, auā ua toe faapea mai Isaia,

verses.en: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.
verses.sm: Ua ia faatauasoina o latou mata, ma na faamaaaina o latou loto, neū vaai o latou mata, ma lagona o latou loto, ne‘i liliuina foi i latou, ma a‘u faamaloloina i latou.

verses.en: These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.
verses.sm: Ka fai mai ia upu e Isaia ina ua vaai atu o ia i lona mamalu, ma tautala mai ia te ia.

verses.en: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:
verses.sm: A e peitai e toatele alii ua talitonu ia te ia; a e leʻi ta‘u atu ai, ona o le au faresaio, ne‘i tulia i latou i le sunako.

verses.en: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.
verses.sm: Auā ua sili lo latou manao i le viiga mai tagata, i le viiga mai le Atua.

verses.en: Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.
verses.sm: Ua alaga atu Iesu, ua fetalai atu, O le faatuatua mai ia te au, e le faatuatua mai o ia ia te au, a e ia te ia ua auina mai a‘u.

verses.en: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me.
verses.sm: O le vaai mai foi ia te au, e vaai atu o ia ia te ia ua auina mai a‘u.

verses.en: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.
verses.sm: Ua ou sau o le malamalama i le lalolagi, ina ia le tumau pea i le pouliuli se tasi e faatuatua mai ia te au.

verses.en: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
verses.sm: Afai foi e faalogologo se tasi i a‘u upu, a e le talitonu i ai, ou te le faasala ia te ia; auā ou te lei sau e faasala i le lalolagi, a ia ou faaolaina le lalolagi.

verses.en: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.
verses.sm: O le faaleaoga ia te au, ma ua le talia a‘u upu, o ia te ia le tasi na te faasalaina ia ; o le upu ua ou tautala atu ai, e faasala lea ia te ia i le aso gataaga.

verses.en: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.
verses.sm: Auā ou te le tautala fua ua o a‘u; a o le Tamā ua auina mai a‘u, na ia tuu mai le poloaiga ia te au i mea ou te fai atu ai, ma mea ou te tautala atu ai.

verses.en: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.
verses.sm: Ua ou iloa foi o lana poloaiga o le ola faavavau lea. O lenei, o mea ou te tautala atu ai, faapei ona fetalai mai ai le Tamā ia te au, e faapea ona ou tautala atu ai. Ua mulumuluina e Iesu o vae o ona
